## Summary
The meeting addressed cultural differences in work-life balance and PTO usage among international teams at Genius Sports. Gregory Phipps highlighted variations, noting that U.S. team members often forego vacation days, while Europeans typically take two weeks off, and Colombian teams have regular Mondays off. Christian Liebenow shared his experience of taking time off, reflecting a European attitude toward breaks. Additionally, the discussion included technical challenges, particularly related to Zoom usage, suggesting a need for better training and standardized meeting tools. Personal sharing among team members was emphasized as a way to foster connection, while managing note-taking tools carefully was deemed essential for maintaining accurate documentation.
